basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Bisha International Student Scholarship (Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.offering_entity: Saudi Ministry of Education & University of Bisha (Asir Province, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Bisha (College of Computing and Information Technology, Asir Province)
basic_details.major_restrictions: College of Computing and Information Technology: Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, and Data Science.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: Approximately 150 to 250 international government scholarships awarded annually across University of Bisha faculties under Saudi External Scholarships program
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Saudi Ministry of Education bilateral country quota: 25 reserved seats allocated annually for Pakistani nationals
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 4 to 5 years for Bachelor of Science (including preparatory year if required); 2 years for Master of Science

nationality_requirements: Non-Saudi citizens residing outside the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (External Scholarship Program)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Undergraduate applicants must be between 17 and 25 years old; Master's applicants must be 30 years old or younger (up to 35 for specific STEM disciplines under MOE guidelines).
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: For Bachelor: Completed Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC / Intermediate / FSc Pre-Engineering / ICS) with minimum 75% marks (or 'Very Good' / Grade B+). For Master: Completed 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) with minimum CGPA 3.00 / 4.00 from an HEC-recognized institution.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Equivalence requirement of 'Very Good' (Jayyid Jiddan) minimum secondary school standing or 3.00/4.00 CGPA for postgraduate programs.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Pre-Engineering or ICS background with strong mathematics and physics grounding for computing and engineering degree tracks.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated within the past 5 years from date of application.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Graduation certificate must not be older than 5 years at the time of application submission.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Work experience is not required for undergraduate or master's admissions.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: English test scores (IELTS/TOEFL) are optional; College of Computing and Information Technology conducts all instruction in English and accepts English Medium of Instruction certificates.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Arabic proficiency is not required for scientific/computing disciplines; an intensive 1-year Arabic language foundation diploma is available for students wishing to pursue humanities courses.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Female candidates must have an eligible Mahram (male guardian) who is also an enrolled student, employed, or legal resident in Saudi Arabia, unless Saudi regulations permit independent university hostel residency for international female scholarship recipients.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants from Pakistan applying through the Saudi Ministry of Education bilateral cultural quota.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Applicant must not have previously held another educational scholarship from an institution in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full international tuition fee waiver across all academic semesters, including preparatory intensive language or STEM modules.

admission_application_fee.details: Application through the official Saudi 'Study in Saudi' (Minhati) portal is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Free furnished student residence in University of Bisha on-campus dormitories with utilities, air conditioning, and high-speed Wi-Fi included.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly government living stipend: SAR 840 / month for Undergraduate students (~PKR 65,000/mo); SAR 1,000 / month for Master's students (~PKR 75,000/mo).

airfare.details: Annual round-trip economy air tickets between Pakistan and Bisha/Abha Airport provided for annual summer break, plus initial flight to Saudi Arabia upon admission.

visa_fee.details: Saudi Student Visa and Iqama (residence permit) issued and renewed annually free of charge by the Saudi government.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive medical and dental care at University of Bisha Medical Clinics and public government hospitals throughout Asir Province.
health_insurance.amount: Full university and public healthcare covered

food_allowance.details: Subsidized nutritious dining options at University of Bisha central student cafeterias (~SAR 3 to 5 per meal).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: One-month stipend allowance provided for books annually, plus graduation book allowance and free textbook loan access.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Laboratory facilities, computer hardware labs, and research project funding supported by the University of Bisha Deanship of Scientific Research.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Funded computing labs and research support

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free university campus shuttle buses operating between student dormitories, computing faculty buildings, central libraries, and sports centers.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university: University of Bisha (Bisha, Asir Province, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Prominent regional public university in southwestern Saudi Arabia, rapidly expanding under Saudi Vision 2030 with specialized College of Computing and Information Technology.
available_majors: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
Bachelor of Science in Information Systems
Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering
Master of Science in Information Systems
Master of Science in Advanced Computing
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Undergraduate: 4 to 5 years (including preparatory foundation); Master: 2 years (4 semesters).
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: HSSC/Intermediate with >= 75% marks or BS with CGPA >= 3.00/4.00, age 17-25 (undergrad) or <= 35 (grad), clean police certificate, GAMCA medical clearance, and HEC/IBCC/MOFA attested documents.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: College of Computing and Information Technology maintains high merit thresholds; Cybersecurity and Computer Science are the most competitive majors.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Apply early on the 'Study in Saudi' portal (minhati.moe.gov.sa / studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa). Ensure all transcripts are attested by IBCC/HEC and MOFA Pakistan before portal upload.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Saudi Ministry of Education Unified 'Study in Saudi' (Minhati) Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create a unified applicant profile on the Saudi Ministry of Education portal (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa), select University of Bisha as destination institution, choose desired computing major, and upload required verified credentials.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Attest academic certificates and transcripts from IBCC/HEC and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) Pakistan; arrange certified Arabic translations.
Step 2: Obtain Police Character Clearance Certificate from Police Khidmat Markaz and get it attested by MOFA Pakistan.
Step 3: Register on the official Saudi 'Study in Saudi' portal (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa) during the September-November application window.
Step 4: Select University of Bisha and submit choice of degree program in the College of Computing and Information Technology.
Step 5: Upload high-resolution scans of passport, attested degrees, medical report, character certificate, and recommendation letters.
Step 6: University of Bisha Admissions Committee conducts academic screening and ranks candidates under the Pakistan country quota (25 seats).
Step 7: Shortlisted nominees undergo Saudi Ministry of Education and Ministry of Foreign Affairs administrative and security vetting (April - June).
Step 8: Final scholarship award notification issued; MOE generates electronic visa authorization number (Visa Slip).
Step 9: Complete medical screening at GAMCA-approved medical center in Pakistan, submit passport to Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia in Islamabad or Consulate in Karachi for Student Visa stamping.
Step 10: University issues complimentary electronic flight ticket; arrive at Abha/Bisha Airport for university reception and hostel check-in.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Government Routing: Admission to University of Bisha via Study in Saudi portal automatically incorporates 100% full government scholarship funding.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Scanned recommendation letters from two academic instructors or college professors uploaded directly to the Study in Saudi portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose outlining academic drive, moral character, and aspirations to contribute to technological development upon degree completion.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not required for undergraduate applicants; Master's applicants provide a 2 to 3-page research proposal in computer science or information systems.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic CV detailing education history, software skills, academic distinctions, and language proficiencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interview is required; selection is determined entirely by academic credentials, quota distribution, and background vetting.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: None mandatory. General Tahsili / Qudurat tests are not required for external international candidates.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Attestation by IBCC/HEC and MOFA Pakistan, followed by Saudi Cultural Mission and Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia upon final selection.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified Arabic translation for all Pakistani educational degrees, marksheets, and police clearance certificates.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the unified Study in Saudi portal.

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must have at least 6 blank pages.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official matriculation, intermediate, or bachelor's degrees and detailed mark sheets.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by IBCC / HEC and MOFA Pakistan, with certified Arabic translation.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official police clearance certificate certifying clean criminal record.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued by Police Khidmat Markaz, attested by MOFA Pakistan with Arabic translation.

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: To be completed at an authorized GAMCA / GCC approved medical center in Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Recommendation letters from prior academic teachers or professors endorsing academic aptitude and character.
Official computerized birth certificate showing parental details.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: NADRA Birth Certificate attested by MOFA Pakistan with Arabic translation.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Annual application cycle conducted via Study in Saudi portal for Fall semester commencement.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 50% (HSSC/Intermediate percentage or Bachelor's CGPA in core STEM subjects)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 10% (For postgraduate applicants; final year project relevance for undergraduates)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 0% (Not required for undergraduate or graduate admission)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (Endorsements from academic teachers regarding aptitude and moral integrity)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: University of Bisha Admissions Board, Saudi Ministry of Education International Scholarships Committee, and Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-tier selection: University ranks qualified applicants by academic marks within country quota (25 seats for Pakistan); Saudi MOE and MOFA grant administrative approvals.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~6,000 to 9,000 international applicants across all participating countries
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~150 to 250 international scholarships across University of Bisha faculties
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~32.0% (Strong acceptance rate due to dedicated bilateral country quota of 25 seats for Pakistan)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 78%+ in Pakistani Intermediate (HSSC / Pre-Engineering / ICS) or 3.20+ CGPA for Master's
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Solid foundation in mathematics and computing, verified clean disciplinary and medical history, fully attested and Arabic-translated document dossier.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Students from Punjab, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Sindh, Balochistan, and AJK holding BISE/FBISE Intermediate certificates.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Indonesia, Egypt, Bangladesh, Yemen, Sudan, Malaysia

fake_websites_and_scams: Unauthorized educational brokers claiming to guarantee admission or charge fees for Saudi government scholarships. The official application on studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa is 100% free.
Scam callers requesting visa processing payments; Saudi student visas and Iqamas are issued completely free of charge.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Saudi government scholarships have ZERO application fees. Any request for payment on portal or through intermediaries is fraudulent.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: University of Bisha and the Saudi Ministry of Education do not collaborate with recruitment agents; direct personal application is mandatory.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Medical examination fee at GAMCA-approved health center in Pakistan (~PKR 18,000 - 25,000).
Document attestation expenses at IBCC, HEC, MOFA, and certified Arabic translation (~PKR 25,000 - 40,000).
Initial pocket money for personal incidentals upon arrival prior to first stipend distribution (~SAR 600 - 1,000; ~PKR 45,000 - 75,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: Computer science classes at University of Bisha are taught only in Arabic. Reality: College of Computing and Information Technology conducts degree coursework in English.
Myth: External scholarship recipients can work jobs off-campus in Saudi Arabia. Reality: Students on study Iqama are legally prohibited from outside commercial employment.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial blogs suggest scholarships can be transferred between Saudi universities; official Ministry of Education regulations strictly prohibit transferring scholarship sponsorship to another institution.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain cumulative GPA of at least 2.75 / 5.00 (Good standing); failure leads to academic warning and eventual scholarship termination.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory full-time attendance; unexcused absenteeism exceeding 20% in any course leads to course denial and disciplinary review.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Termly academic performance audits submitted to the Deanship of Admissions and Registration.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Holders of international student residency (Iqama) are legally prohibited from outside commercial employment in the Kingdom.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Graduates must depart the Kingdom upon completion of studies within the timeframe stipulated by Saudi immigration authorities (typically 3 months).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero post-graduation service bond or financial repayment obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Award is terminated upon academic failure or disciplinary expulsion; previously disbursed stipends and allowances are non-refundable and not clawed back.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Transfer to another university within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia is strictly prohibited for external scholarship recipients.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Major changes are permitted only within the same faculty during the first academic year subject to college council approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship duration cannot exceed the standard graduation timeline plus one optional semester with explicit approval from the Ministry of Education.
